title: Story: I was among the few journalists who got to test [the iPhone]...
speaker: Steve Jobs
content: I was among the few journalists who got to test [the iPhone] before its release. Soon after I received the unit, I was walking down Broadway and my test unit got a call from "Unknown." It was Jobs, ostensibly wanting to know what I thought, but actually making sure I understood how amazing it was. I acknowledged that it was extraordinary, but mentioned to him that maybe nothing could match the expectations he had generated. People were calling it the "Jesus phone." Didn't that worry him? The answer was no. "We are going to blow away the expectations," he told me.
